summary: This document outlines the transformative legacy projects spearheaded or facilitated by Professor Isa Ali Pantami in Gombe State from 2016 to 2023 during his tenures as Director-General of NITDA and Minister of Communications and Digital Economy. Over 241 projects were executed across ICT infrastructure, capacity building, digital literacy, and community interventions. Gombe State was positioned as a central hub for technology in the North-East zone, alongside significant non-ICT legacy projects in healthcare, infrastructure, and social investments.
